# Security · data

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-blocks.mjs from scripts/blocks-meta.json. Edit that file, not this one. -->

### TLS
- What: Encrypt traffic between the browser and the server; it is the padlock in the address bar.
- Applies when: the app is going live on the internet.
- Stage: go-live
- Kind: checkable

### Encryption at rest
- What: Encrypt stored data so a stolen disk or backup cannot be read.
- Applies when: the app stores highly sensitive data.
- Stage: with-users
- Kind: checkable

### Secure cookies
- What: Cookie settings that keep the login cookie away from scripts and other sites.
- Applies when: a web app keeps users logged in with cookies.
- Stage: day-one-if
- Kind: checkable
- Proof: test
- Done when: The login cookie is set with HttpOnly, Secure and SameSite.

### PII minimization
- What: Collect only the personal data a feature actually needs.
- Applies when: the app collects personal data.
- Stage: day-one-if
- Kind: checkable
- Proof: review
- Done when: Every personal field the app collects is used by a feature in the plan. Nothing is collected just in case.

### Security headers
- What: Extra instructions the server sends that turn on the browser's built-in protections.
- Applies when: a web app is going live.
- Stage: go-live
- Kind: checkable

### Trusted client IP
- What: Work out the visitor's real address correctly when the app sits behind a proxy.
- Applies when: the app sits behind a proxy and uses the visitor's address.
- Stage: go-live
- Kind: checkable
